opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A, Genetics Society/SIG meetings), up to £500 (Scheme B, non-Society meetings), up to £300 (Scheme C, virtual conferences); up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's, PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of their PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of their PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference. Supervisors providing support letters must be current Society members.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in genetics, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs across three streams (Society/SIG meetings, non-Society meetings, and virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year. Supervisors providing support letters must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques, covering travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration/tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year. Supervisors providing support letters must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Funded by income from the journal Heredity, supports travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects whose results would typically be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society with caring responsibilities attending a Society meeting; priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £60/day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Genetics Society scientific meetings and events, claimable in arrears on production of receipts.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session for up to about £1,000, or as major sponsor several thousand pounds (major sponsorship levels in last 12 months between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society organising genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Society; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed one-off meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, used towards organisation of a meeting (not attendance), including a Carer's Award, with several levels of sponsorship available.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society; funding covers eligible travel and materials costs (UK-based, budget/economy class travel).
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings, supporting speaker travel, accommodation, publicity and other direct meeting costs.
